jobs.occupation: Inside sales | German market | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international company operating within the food sector. With a family-business mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and strong growth ambitions, they offer a fast-paced environment where initiative and results are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

•  Proactively identify and develop new business opportunities within the German market.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Manage the full sales cycle, from lead generation to closing deals.
• Conduct commercial negotiations and follow up on sales opportunities.
• Expand the customer portfolio and strengthen market presence.
• Analyze sales performance and market trends.
• Report on sales activities and contribute to the overall sales strategy.

•  Fluent in German and English, knowledge of Dutch or additional languages is a strong asset.

jobs.occupation: Key Account Manager | FMCG Non-Food | Relocation to Paris
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international player in the Non-Food FMCG sector, recognized for its portfolio of strong consumer brands and its commitment to innovation, quality, and sustainable growth. Present across multiple European markets, the company partners with major retailers and continuously invests in developing its brands, people, and commercial capabilities.

Jobomschrijving

The Key Account Manager will have the following responsibilities :

• Develop and manage strategic relationships with key retail accounts across Belgium and Luxembourg.
• Lead annual commercial negotiations, including pricing, promotions, trade terms, and joint business plans.
• Identify growth opportunities and implement account strategies to achieve sales and profitability targets.
• Drive category expansion, product launches, and promotional activations with retail partners.
• Monitor sales performance, market trends, and competitor activity to recommend corrective actions and growth initiatives.
• Prepare forecasts, business reviews, and account performance analyses for internal and external stakeholders.
• Ensure excellence in customer management while maximizing brand visibility and market share.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a Key Account Manager or similar commercial role within FMCG
• Proven experience negotiating with Belgian retail chains.
• Excellent negotiation and relationship-building skills.
• Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
• Fluent in French & Dutch. English is a strong asset.
• Willingness to relocate to Paris.

Our client is an international market leader in consumer electronics, with a strong presence in Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage and further develop the commercial partnership with the partner operating the four branded stores in Belgium.

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.

• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.

• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.

• You contribute to achieving targets.

• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.

• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  

• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  

• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.

• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

• Providing general technical support

As a Business Analyst, you start from the business and its processes rather than from a predefined IT solution. You engage with various stakeholders, identify their challenges and needs, and seek to understand how processes actually work today.
You analyze the current way of working, identify bottlenecks and opportunities, and work together with the business to define a clear as-is and to-be situation. You ask critical questions, align different interests and help determine which changes can deliver the greatest added value.
You then translate these insights into clear business requirements, processes, objectives and solution directions. Throughout this process, you maintain a view of the bigger picture and ensure that proposed solutions align with operational reality and the broader digitalization strategy.
You work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, Architects, Functional Analysts and development teams. While the more functional or technical profiles focus in greater detail on the concrete software implementation, you remain primarily responsible for the business context, process logic, scope and stakeholder alignment.
Throughout the project, you remain involved in validation and decision-making, ensuring that the final solution genuinely addresses the original business problem.

• 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role. More experience is certainly welcome
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
• You have strong communication skills and can interact comfortably with operational employees, management and IT professionals
• You communicate professionally in English and understand Dutch and French
